label: PV
description: Photovoltaic production. Plant bare sens_pv_production_active is the AC sum; optional entity-scoped pv.{pv_system_id}.sens_pv_production_active on pv_systems[].ehal_bindings (DC string). Plant may be derived from Σ grid-tied inv.*.sens_inv_power_pv · η_inv when unmapped.

ehal_fields.notes: Plant AC PV sum in W (≥ 0), or per-PV-system DC power as pv.{id}.sens_pv_production_active. Required on the live wire unless plant is derived from a complete grid-tied inverter/PV map. Cumulative kWh counter is removed (2.4.j).

unit_sign_notes: See docs/referenz/ehal.md § Units and sign convention / Multi-inverter live PV attribution.
